propositions: s3_doctor._fold_heads currently merges bundle heads into the worktree HEAD via git merge, making the heal result dependent on the checked-out branch
_require_tracker_on_ref refuses healing when the tracker is on a different branch or detached HEAD, preventing heals in those states
_fold_heads must be rewritten to fold into refs/heads/<ref> using git merge-tree and git commit-tree instead of git merge, independent of worktree state
The publish step must update refs/heads/<ref> via git update-ref (off-branch) or git reset --hard (on-branch), and _require_tracker_on_ref must be deleted
A side-branch or detached-HEAD tracker must heal successfully without moving the checked-out branch or worktree
The merge=ours driver for .bridge_state/* collisions must be preserved through the merge-tree rewrite and verified by new regression tests
